title: anydoc converts Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV and PDF into Markdown
description:
anydoc converts Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV and PDF into Markdown, written in Rust with Node and Python bindings. Every format parses into one shared document model and renders through one serializer, so a table-escaping fix for docx fixes rtf and odt at the same time. Format detection reads the bytes rather than the extension, so mislabeled files still convert. #github #opensource 

https://github.com/firecrawl/anydoc
